description: A policy that passes REC-005 through D-1 but also cites the absence claim F-17 to say the repository holds no SQL is rejected.
section: IMPL §3.3.5 step 4 (REC-010), §1.11 (an absence claim cannot support a broader absence), §3.8

recommendations.content: New HTTP calls go through the shared client, and the repository holds no SQL.
recommendations.rationale: The developer confirmed the client rule, and no SQL files were found.
